description: This file implements the SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) scheduling logic for 5G NR, including slot-based scheduling, handling different SSB pattern cases, and calculating SSB parameters based on frequency and slot index.

classes.name: ssb_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling SSBs in a 5G NR cell, handling different pattern cases and slot timing.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SSBs for a given slot, handling first run and subsequent slots.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Resets the scheduler to initial state.

methods.name: schedule_ssb
methods.description: Performs the actual scheduling of SSBs within a slot, based on pattern case and frequency.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_A_C
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern cases A and C based on frequency and slot index.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_B
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern case B based on frequency and slot index.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_D
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern case D based on slot timing and predefined slot pairs.

methods.name: fill_ssb_parameters
methods.description: Fills in the SSB information structure with calculated parameters for transmission.
